@@U04242@@
down onto rocky flats, roaring and foaming every which way, and step by step down into the valley. What good is heroic resistance to such power? I find even myself shuddering with dread.

@@U04244@@
I see nothing of these watery lies. Only human eyes can be deceived. But it amuses me all the same. Look at them, masses of them out there, the fools, thinking they're drowning, running, paddling the air like swimmers, when all the while they’re standing on solid ground. A madhouse of confusion!

@@U04245@@
(The ravens have returned.)

@@U04246@@
I'll see our exalted Master hears of your industry. And yet, if you're so minded, and want to prove masters yourselves, hurry off to the glowing smithy where the dwarf folk never tire at hammering sparks from metal and stone. Persuade them without fail to give you fire— brilliant, flashing, sputtering, exploding— fire such as sparkles in our Master's mind. Heat lightning from afar, or the fall of remotest stars, are common sights on a summer’s night. But lightning playing in a confusion of shrubbery, and stars hissing along the moistened earth— these are sights have power to amaze. Don’t put yourselves out too much, of course: ask politely first, and then insist.

@@U04247@@
(The ravens fly off. The display described takes place.)
translation:
@@U04242@@
下到岩石平坦的地方，四面八方咆哮着，冒着泡沫，一步一步进入山谷。英勇抵抗这样的力量有什么好处呢？我发现连我自己都因恐惧而颤抖。

@@U04244@@
我对这些淡薄的谎言一无所知。只有人的眼睛才会被欺骗。但它仍然让我感到有趣。看看他们，一大群傻瓜，以为自己快要被淹死了，一边奔跑，一边像游泳者一样在空中划水，而实际上他们一直站在坚实的地面上。混乱的疯人院！

@@U04245@@
（乌鸦回来了。）

@@U04246@@
我会看看我们尊贵的师父听说过你们的行业。然而，如果你有这样的想法，并且想证明自己是大师，那就赶紧前往发光的铁匠铺吧，那里的矮人不知疲倦地用金属和石头锤打火花。说服他们，一定要给你火焰——明亮的、闪烁的、溅射的、爆炸的——就像我们主心中闪闪发光的火焰。来自远处的热闪电，或者最遥远的星星的坠落，是夏夜常见的景象。但闪电在杂乱的灌木丛中划过，星星在湿润的大地上嘶嘶作响——这些景象都令人惊叹不已。当然，不要太过分：先礼貌地询问，然后再坚持。

@@U04247@@
（乌鸦飞走了。所描述的显示发生了。）
